activity.notes: Recorded astronomical observations at Alexandria run from 127 to 151 CE; this distinguishes the astronomer from the Ptolemaic kings.

sources.title: Ptolemy — Encyclopaedia Britannica 1911
sources.citation_text: Ptolemy's first recorded observation is dated 127 CE and his last 151 CE, at Alexandria under Roman rule.
